page_title: HAV 2-1 ANG | Le Havre v Angers 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' A corner kick by Angers is thwarted by the well prepared Paul Argney (Le Havre).
90+1' Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Paul Argney was alert and made a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Marius Courcoul and he is replaced by Lanroy Machine (Angers).
88' Noam Obougou (Le Havre) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
86' Marius Courcoul (Angers) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
83' Here comes a substitution. Kenny Quetant is given a rest as he is replaced by Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre).

81' 2 - 1 Goal! Rassoul Ndiaye produces a great pass that finds Noam Obougou (Le Havre) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 2:1.
78' Flag goes up against Loic Nego (Le Havre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Melvin Zinga makes a great save to stop his effort.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Prosper Peter (Angers) replaces Louis Mouton.
72' A rebound falls at the feet of Carlens Arcus (Angers) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
72' Angers take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Angers have been awarded a corner kick.
70' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

69' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
66' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Yassine Kechta is replaced by Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre).
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Noam Obougou (Le Havre) coming on for Felix Mambimbi.

64' Marius Courcoul (Angers) has a great opportunity but fails to score. The ball from the corner falls to him to unleash a shot towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off a great save to deny him.
64' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' Carlens Arcus (Angers) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
62' Angers fail to score from a corner as Paul Argney (Le Havre) leaps to collect the ball.
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Angers will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) is replacing Amine Sbai.
58' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacques Ekomie (Angers) replacing Florent Hanin.
57' Substitution. Simon Ebonog walks off the pitch and Daren Nbenbege Mosengo (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
55' 1 - 1 What a goal! Carlens Arcus plays it to Louis Mouton (Angers), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Paul Argney into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
54' Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
50' Carlens Arcus (Angers) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem ignores the protests.
46' Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.
42' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the crossbar!
42' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
41' Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
35' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' The linesman signals that Louis Mouton (Angers) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.
26' Amine Sbai (Angers) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Angers get a corner.
26' Amine Sbai (Angers) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
25' Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.

21' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Rassoul Ndiaye plays the ball to the feet of Kenny Quetant (Le Havre), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 1:0.
13' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Melvin Zinga was alert and made a comfortable save.
13' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

9' The corner is slung over and Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
9' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Le Havre.
5' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
4' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Yassine Belkhdim (Angers). Angers force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Angers will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
